outputs.bab-01-moon-star: Night of the 11th, beginning of the night, the moon was 1 cubit 8 fingers in front of α Tauri.
outputs.bab-02-moon-planet: Night of the 2nd, the moon was 1 1/2 cubits behind Jupiter, with Saturn nearby to the west.
outputs.bab-03-planet-planet:
- Venus: visible
- Mars: visible
- separation: 3 fingers
outputs.bab-04-heliacal-rising: The 13th, Venus' first appearance in the east in Scorpius; this portends that the king will fall and there will be war.
outputs.bab-05-lunar-first-visibility: The 1st, it was bright and low, and the night passed without cloud.
